headline: Find the constraint before it becomes the production plan
capabilities: Perform real-time analysis on key production metrics across stations and lines
Identify and propose solutions to  throughput constraints
Plan to optimize processes, crew allocation, and investments
Scale capacity to meet the seasonal demand surge
outcomes: Increased line capacity and reduced cycle times through targeted optimizations
Higher Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and throughput, exceeding holiday targets
Consistent high quality and increased ROI on investments
why_try: It makes operational AI concrete: a plant manager can ask where output is being lost, see the constraining station, and evaluate process, equipment, quality, or staffing responses.

sample_prompts.label: See which production line needs attention
sample_prompts.prompt: Which production line needs attention today, and what is driving the loss?

sample_prompts.label: Find the constraining station
sample_prompts.prompt: Where is the bottleneck on each line, and which station should the plant team address first?

sample_prompts.label: Compare throughput improvement options
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the practical options to improve throughput without hiding the quality tradeoffs.

sample_prompts.label: Build the three-shift production plan
sample_prompts.prompt: Translate the current line performance into a day, swing, and night shift plan.
